headline: New Limits and Algorithms in Quantum Simulation
summary: Today's papers explore the capabilities and boundaries of quantum simulation, spanning field theories and nonlinear dynamics to conditions where quantum thermal states become classically tractable. Researchers demonstrate how specialized representations—like QSP polynomials and continuous qumodes—drastically lower gate requirements. Together, they clarify where true quantum advantage persists.

themes.title: Algorithms for Quantum Simulation
themes.body: New algorithmic methods tackle challenging dynamics on quantum hardware. One approach uses Quantum Signal Processing to preserve exact chiral symmetry in Dirac fermions, while another leverages hybrid oscillator-qubit processors for oracle-free nonlinear simulation.

themes.title: Classical Limits of Thermal Quantum States
themes.body: Investigating finite-temperature regimes reveals that entanglement and quantum magic decay at constant temperatures regardless of system size. This bound enables polynomial-time classical algorithms to prepare Gibbs states once quantum correlations vanish.
